generator: Original test-only OpenSSL TSA and local DER encoders; private keys are excluded.
purpose: One-object RFC 4998 ERS input, exact archived bytes, certificates and original RFC 3161 requests. The embedded ATS fields contain signed CMS ContentInfo tokens, not TimeStampResp wrappers.

negativeDerivations.ers-timestamp-renewal-over-whole-ats: Valid signed token covers the entire preceding ATS DER instead of its timestamp ContentInfo.
negativeDerivations.ers-timestamp-renewal-over-inner-content: Valid signed token covers only the inner content bytes of the preceding ContentInfo, omitting its tag and length.
negativeDerivations.ers-timestamp-renewal-over-original-data: The first valid signed document token is repeated as a second ATS instead of covering the preceding token.
negativeDerivations.ers-hash-renewal-reversed-pair: Valid signed token covers H(H(prior sequence) || H(data)) instead of the declared numbered-step order.
negativeDerivations.ers-hash-renewal-direct-sorted: Valid signed token directly covers the Figure 4 sorted pair rather than the declared numbered-step order.
negativeDerivations.ers-hash-renewal-bare-chains: Valid signed token covers H(data) plus H(prior chain DER without ArchiveTimeStampSequence framing).
negativeDerivations.ers-hash-renewal-no-history: Valid signed token covers H(data) plus an all-zero history hash.
negativeDerivations.ers-hash-renewal-time-reversed-v2: Validly re-signed CMS token retains imprint and request binding but claims a time before its predecessor.
negativeDerivations.ers-reduced-tree-wrong-leaf: Candidate data digest replaced in a frozen reduced tree.
negativeDerivations.ers-reduced-tree-wrong-sibling: Sibling digest replaced while retaining the signed token.
negativeDerivations.ers-reduced-tree-unsorted: Same digests encoded in descending rather than binary ascending order.
negativeDerivations.ers-initial-bad-token-signature: Original corrupted CMS signature from timestamp corpus embedded as ERS ContentInfo.
